# Solana SDK

`solana-web3-1.98.4.js` is the browser IIFE bundle from the official npm package `@solana/web3.js` version 1.98.4, downloaded from:

https://registry.npmjs.org/@solana/web3.js/-/web3.js-1.98.4.tgz

Only the browser bundle and its original MIT license (`SOLANA-WEB3-LICENSE.txt`) are included. It is served locally. No package installation scripts are executed.

Integration references:
- https://docs.phantom.com/solana/sending-a-transaction
- https://solana.com/docs/tools/solana-pay/quickstart/transfer-requests
- https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http/gettransaction
